text:
sam: hey @runtime @security — pinging for quick eyes on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8134. small change to runtime routing: add fallback to cpu-quantized variant when GPU pool is saturated. needs security confirmation for KMS usage + platform for canary plan. TL;DR: adds header `X-Prefer-Quant: true`, env var `FALLBACK_KMS_KEY`, and a metric `fallback_to_q`

lucy: looking now. quick q — do you have p99 perf numbers? curious about worst-case tail impact.

sam: yup, added microbench results in the PR under `bench/fallback_bench.md`. p50 ~ unchanged, p99 +7ms on 512-token sequences in our test infra. should be within SLO but worth eyeballing. I can paste raw numbers if helpful. :mag_right:

owen: @sam on the KMS bit — are you encrypting the KV cache payloads or only metadata/config? security needs the scope + threat model (who can decrypt, key rotation plan).

sam: encrypting only the KV prefix cache metadata (not user content). key is only used by runtime instances; rotation follows our normal KMS rotation policy. I'll add a short threat-model blurb to the PR description and link the key ARN we intend to use.

meena: platform here — I can own the canary schedule. two asks before I sign off: (1) add a feature-flag gate (default off) so we can toggle fallback quickly, (2) add an integration test that forces GPU fullness and asserts `X-Prefer-Quant` is sent and fallback metric increments. after that I can give a partial LGTM and book a canary slot.

lucy: also left a small comment in the allocator path (line ~210) about a possible null check — looks minor but please address.

sam: thanks — will push fixes today: add flag, integration test, threat-model blurb, and fix the allocator comment. assigning @meena as canary owner and @owen for final security sign-off. tagging deploy-bot to reserve tentative slot once changes land. :handshake:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary slot tentatively reserved for PR #8134 on 2024-10-03 22:00 UTC. To confirm, run `/deploy confirm pr/8134` in #deploys or reply here.

meena: noted — I'll confirm after the PR update.

sam: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick eyes. will update the PR and ping when ready for final checks. :rocket:
